status: PASS only after every applicable criterion passes; FAIL otherwise
source_sha: Exact implementation/configuration Git commit; evidence-only commit may follow
environment: Declared actual local/dev/test/prod target and runtime
dependency_gates: Paths + SHA256 + status; no failed dependency override
contract_hashes: Relative safe file path -> SHA256, including exact approval/test/price contracts

criteria.measure: Actual value and unit, not a copied target
criteria.owner: Named accountable reviewer; NOT_APPLICABLE also requires explicit reason

tests: Commands, exit codes, report hashes, counts, failures and clocks; local tests are not tenant probes
measurements: Actual measured values plus separate modeled estimates
costs: Settled + outstanding + conservative reservations + remaining-work estimate across both subscriptions
limitations: Explicit unsupported cases and unrun future gates
owner_signoff: Actor, authority and timestamp; no fabricated independent approval
